security.subtitle: Unrest, terror, corruption and threats to your presidency
security.mapCaption: Schematic map: regions are not to scale and no borders are drawn. Unrest here is caused by jobs, prices, corruption, approval and policing: never by religion or caste.
security.borderNote: Set by the most hostile neighbour
security.safetyNote: Rises with police and intelligence funding and loyal Home, Defence and Intelligence ministers; falls with the terror threat.

risks.impeachmentNote: Parliament acts after {{months}} months below {{threshold}}% ({{count}} so far)
risks.coupNote: Generals become restless above {{threshold}}. Keep the defence minister loyal and approval high.
risks.assassinationNote: Attempts follow the terror threat; funding and loyal guards decide whether they succeed.
risks.bankruptcyNote: Default if debt stays above {{ratio}}% for {{months}} months ({{count}} so far)

security.strikesIn_one: Expected to strike in about {{count}} day
security.strikesIn_other: Expected to strike in about {{count}} days

raid.label: Launch a raid
raid.summary: Strike suspected cells now. Cuts the terror threat and may stop a live plot, but a botched raid costs approval and stirs unrest.

surveillance.label: Expand surveillance
surveillance.summary: Slow and quiet: for four months the threat falls, intelligence catches more plots and live plots are harder to carry out.

borderSeal.label: Seal the border
borderSeal.summary: Shut crossings for two months. Sharply cuts the threat and blunts live plots, but trade and growth suffer.

security.inquiriesNote: National corruption index {{corruption}}/100. An inquiry costs {{cost}}, takes about {{days}} days and may expose a minister; the agency runs up to {{max}} at a time. A better-funded Anti-corruption ministry finds more.
